strings.MediaEngine.AcornRepresentation: Source format '{0}' does not contain complete validated sectors for Acorn target '{1}'.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornRawAdfLoss: The raw file is regrouped into the validated Acorn ADF sectors without changing its bytes. Raw files contain no recorded sector identifiers or checksums.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornRawDfsLoss: The raw file is regrouped into the validated BBC DFS sectors without changing its bytes. Raw files contain no recorded sector identifiers or checksums.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornJfdLoss: JFD container metadata is not preserved in the raw ADF representation.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornCpcLoss: CPCEMU container headers, track layout and timing are not preserved in the raw ADF representation.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornTd0Loss: TeleDisk header, comment, track order and container metadata are not preserved in the raw ADF representation.
strings.MediaEngine.AcornTrailingLoss: Empty trailing track-table slots outside the target profile are omitted; all target sectors are present.
